label: Not about air-pollution assessment or exposure
rule: Air pollution is not the topic (not in the title or author keywords, fewer than three mentions in the abstract), or particulates only in an aquatic or soil context

label: Proxy in an unrelated sense
rule: Palaeo-environmental archive, or a computational surrogate/emulator with no geospatial data layer

label: Non-geospatial proxy
rule: Biomonitor or biomarker as the proxy, with no geospatial data layer alongside

label: Indoor or occupational only
rule: Indoor/occupational setting with no outdoor, ambient or geospatial component

label: Process or inventory study
rule: Emission inventory, atmospheric chemistry, field campaign or model-process study with no exposure, proxy or mapping aim

label: No geospatial proxy
rule: No geospatial proxy family and no spatial component

label: Excluded on human review
rule: Included by the rules but judged off-topic on the human title check

label: Retained
rule: Uses, compares, validates or reviews geospatial or environmental proxies to assess air pollution or exposure
